purpose: Original pixel-game roles and inventory props; decorative only
prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable sprite atlas for HoldBook 2D pixel-game educational demo. Create one PNG sprite sheet with GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, 1536x1024, exactly four equal columns by two equal rows, eight separate centered sprites, generous empty margins in each equal cell, no dividers or labels. Consistent crisp 16-bit pixel art, straight-on side view, dark navy outline, stepped square pixels, no blur, no 3D/isometric rendering, no shadows outside sprites. Row1 left to right: (1) small adult fictional Seller broker character in champagne-gold jacket holding a folder, (2) adult fictional Buyer broker character in cyan jacket holding a wallet, (3) adult Admin clerk in muted purple jacket carrying a credential clipboard, (4) a closed blue-steel escrow vault with champagne locking wheel. Row2 left to right: (1) ivory paper equity certificate with small gold seal and purely abstract lines, (2) large gold square-edged share token with a simple four-point star emblem, (3) white/silver square-edged currency token with two horizontal bars emblem, (4) a blue-steel eligibility checkpoint terminal with cyan screen and a small gate arm. Each sprite occupies at most central 65 percent of its cell. Adult characters full body feet visible. All objects and characters fit wholly within their own cell. Transparent pixels between every sprite. No text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logos, gradients. Original characters and assets, not from any existing game.

Edit this sprite atlas. Keep the same eight pixel-art sprites, exact four-column two-row layout, palette, character designs and object designs. Reduce each sprite to fit inside the central 65% of its cell so no sprite crosses a cell boundary; each cell is exactly one quarter width and one half height. Do not add anything. Crisp square pixel edges, no glow. Preserve order: Seller, Buyer, Admin, vault / certificate, gold share token, silver payment token, gate. This is a production sprite sheet, each sprite must be independently usable against any background.

Production correction of this sprite sheet, keeping all eight character/object designs and their order. No transparency, no checkerboard, no gradients or glow. It will be used as eight framed pixel-game inventory portraits. On a 1536x1024 canvas divide into four equal columns and two equal rows without visible dividers. Center each sprite precisely at x=192,576,960,1344; row1 center y=256 and row2 center y=768. Eight separate centered portraits, background all exactly the same flat navy.
